name: Daily Brief (George)
tagline: A two-minute morning read that assembles your day
description: One short briefing when you wake up. Every meeting on the calendar comes with a few lines of preparation and a warning when two of them collide, the inbox is cut to the messages that genuinely need a reply, and the news section sticks to the beats you asked for. It reads and summarises only; it sends nothing for you.
author: gzikry
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
